test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Giving orders in a manner that permits no refusal
solution: The correct answer is '**Dictatorial**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Dictatorial**'. • It means 'connected with or controlled by a ruler who has total power, especially one who rules by force (a dictator)'. (तानाशाह से संबंधित, तानाशाही, अधिनायकीय) • *Example: a **dictatorial** regime...* **Correct Answer:__** *Dictatorial.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Infidelity**: the act of not being faithful to your wife or husband by having a sexual relationship with somebody else. [पति या पत्‍नी की साथी से बेवफ़ाई (अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति से यौन संबंध बनाकर), विश्‍वासघात] • **Benedictory**: relating to the giving of a blessing. (आशीर्वाद देने के संबंध में) • **Adulterous**: of or involving adultery. (व्‍यभिचारी) 33:Tb47, The correct answer is '**diminishes**'.
